card.name: Per-hour endings of dose rates
card.fires_on: The piece after a dose unit such as mcg or mg that completes a per-time rate, such as h in mcg/h, hour in mcg/hour, hr, or day. It appears in dosing, infusion and patch-strength text.

modes.label: Split "hour" after unit
modes.description: The "h" or "hr" piece that follows mcg, mg or mL/kg and completes "per hour".

modes.label: Per-day ending
modes.description: The word "day" completing a per-day rate after a mcg amount.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a dose rate such as mcg/hour is being finished with its time part.
